about: Renders a table of records, with a caption, column and row headers, and a total row.

align.about: Vertical alignment of a cell in a row taller than one line. The notes wrap, so each value shows.
align.title: Alignment

banded.about: Column headers on `bg.subtle`, in capitals. Use it where several tables follow one another, so the reader sees where each table starts.
banded.title: Banded headers

bridgeNote: Held for a customs count, released on the second of the month
caption: Payouts raised this quarter

empty.about: A table with no rows renders the `empty` content in one full-width cell.
empty.title: An empty table

interactive.about: Body rows that fill under the pointer and while a link inside them has focus. The second row shows the fill.
interactive.title: Interactive rows

layout.about: Columns sized to their content, and columns sized from declared widths. An auto table shrinks its columns to fit the scroller, so a table that scrolls sideways declares its widths.
layout.title: Layouts

palette.about: Every palette, on an interactive table. The second row shows the palette's fill.
palette.title: Palettes

quarters.about: A header that spans the columns under it, over a row of month headers. A spanning header states `scope="colgroup"`, so a screen reader reads it with each column under it.
quarters.title: Headers that span columns

radius.about: Every corner radius of the scroller.
radius.title: Corners

rules.about: Rules between rows, between rows and columns, or none. The rule under the headers and the rule over the total render in every value.
rules.title: Rules

runs.about: A row header that spans the rows of one account. It states `scope="rowgroup"`, and each account is a `tbody` of its own.
runs.title: Headers that span rows

sections.about: Rows grouped into a `tbody` per state by `groupBy`. Each section's heading states `scope="rowgroup"`.
sections.title: Sections

sorting.about: Columns that sort on a press of their names. The table reports the press, and the caller sorts the rows. A sorted column's header states `aria-sort`, and the arrow is part of the column's label.
sorting.title: Sorting

stickyBoth.about: Sticky header rows and a sticky first column, scrolled both ways. The corner cell renders above both.
stickyBoth.title: Sticky header and column

stickyColumn.about: A table wider than its scroller, scrolled sideways. The week names stay at the start.
stickyColumn.title: Sticky first column

stickyHeader.about: A table taller than its scroller, scrolled down two rows. The column headers stay at the top. The scroller needs a maximum height.
stickyHeader.title: Sticky header

title: Table
